query.statement: SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, DESCRIPTION, DISPLAY_ORDER, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_PARAMETER_GROUP WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER, GROUP_NAME

SELECT PARAMETER_ID, PARAMETER_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, GROUP_ID, UNIT, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, LOWER_CONTROL_LIMIT, UPPER_CONTROL_LIMIT, SAMPLING_INTERVAL_MS, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_PARAMETER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@groupId IS NULL OR GROUP_ID = @groupId) ORDER BY PARAMETER_NAME

SELECT ALARM_CONFIG_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, ALARM_LEVEL, OPERATOR, THRESHOLD_VALUE, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_ALARM_CONFIG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@parameterId IS NULL OR PARAMETER_ID = @parameterId) ORDER BY PARAMETER_ID, ALARM_LEVEL

SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, OPERATOR, THRESHOLD_VALUE, ACTION, PRIORITY, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_INTERLOCK_RULE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@parameterId IS NULL OR PARAMETER_ID = @parameterId) ORDER BY PARAMETER_ID, PRIORITY

SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_CONFIG_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, ALARM_LEVEL, TRIGGER_VALUE, MESSAGE, OCCURRED_AT, CLEARED_AT, IS_CLEARED FROM FDC_ALARM_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND OCCURRED_AT >= @from AND OCCURRED_AT <= @to ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC

SELECT HISTORY_ID, RULE_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, TRIGGER_VALUE, ACTION, MESSAGE, TRIGGERED_AT, RESOLVED_AT, IS_RESOLVED FROM FDC_INTERLOCK_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND TRIGGERED_AT >= @from AND TRIGGERED_AT <= @to ORDER BY TRIGGERED_AT DESC

SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, DESCRIPTION, DISPLAY_ORDER, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_PARAMETER_GROUP WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER, GROUP_NAME

SELECT PARAMETER_ID, PARAMETER_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, GROUP_ID, UNIT, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, LOWER_CONTROL_LIMIT, UPPER_CONTROL_LIMIT, SAMPLING_INTERVAL_MS, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_PARAMETER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@groupId IS NULL OR GROUP_ID = @groupId) ORDER BY PARAMETER_NAME

SELECT HISTORY_ID, RULE_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, TRIGGER_VALUE, ACTION, MESSAGE, TRIGGERED_AT, RESOLVED_AT, IS_RESOLVED FROM FDC_INTERLOCK_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@isResolved IS NULL OR IS_RESOLVED = @isResolved) ORDER BY TRIGGERED_AT DESC

SELECT TOP 500 COLLECT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, VALUE, COLLECTED_AT, QUALITY, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT FROM FDC_COLLECT_DATA WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@parameterId IS NULL OR PARAMETER_ID = @parameterId) ORDER BY COLLECTED_AT DESC

SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PARAMETER_ID, OPERATOR, THRESHOLD_VALUE, ACTION, PRIORITY, IS_ACTIVE FROM FDC_INTERLOCK_RULE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@parameterId IS NULL OR PARAMETER_ID = @parameterId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, PRIORITY DESC

SELECT PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, EVENT_NAME, EVENT_ON, EVENT_OFF, CONDITION_FORMULA, DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM FDC_VIRTUAL_EVENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID

MERGE FDC_VIRTUAL_EVENT WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @equipmentId AS EQUIPMENT_ID, @eventId AS EVENT_ID) AS s ON t.EQUIPMENT_ID = s.EQUIPMENT_ID AND t.EVENT_ID = s.EVENT_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = @plantId, EVENT_NAME = @eventName, EVENT_ON = @eventOn, EVENT_OFF = @eventOff, CONDITION_FORMULA = @conditionFormula, DESCRIPTION = @description, VALID_STATE = 'Valid', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, EVENT_NAME, EVENT_ON, EVENT_OFF, CONDITION_FORMULA, DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@plantId, @equipmentId, @eventId, @eventName, @eventOn, @eventOff, @conditionFormula, @description, 'Valid', @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
UPDATE FDC_VIRTUAL_EVENT SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND EVENT_ID = @eventId

SELECT TOP 500 PARAMETER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS N, ROUND(AVG(VALUE), 4) AS AVG_VALUE, MIN(VALUE) AS MIN_VALUE, MAX(VALUE) AS MAX_VALUE, ROUND(MAX(VALUE) - MIN(VALUE), 4) AS RANGE_VALUE, ROUND(AVG(VALUE * VALUE) - AVG(VALUE) * AVG(VALUE), 6) AS VARIANCE_VALUE FROM FDC_COLLECT_DATA WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@parameterId IS NULL OR PARAMETER_ID = @parameterId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) GROUP BY PARAMETER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID ORDER BY PARAMETER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID

SELECT TOP 200 HISTORY_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, EVENT_STATE, FORMULA, DETAILS, EVALUATED_AT FROM FDC_VIRTUAL_EVENT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@eventId IS NULL OR EVENT_ID = @eventId) ORDER BY EVALUATED_AT DESC
